title: Rani ki Vav - Subterranean Pavilion 360°
caption: Equirectangular view of the multi-tiered pillared gallery and sculpted Vishnu niches

hotspots.title: Sheshashayi Vishnu Relief
hotspots.text: Monumental high-relief carving of Lord Vishnu resting upon the serpent Shesha amidst celestial attendants.

hotspots.title: Solanki Torana Columns
hotspots.text: Multi-tiered pillared pavilions featuring intricate geometric cusped arches characteristic of 11th-century Solanki craftsmanship.

hotspots.title: Saraswati Aquifer Siphon
hotspots.text: Circular deep well shaft engineered to harness the underground subterranean water table of the Saraswati river basin.

hotspots.title: Apsara & Nymph Friezes
hotspots.text: Intricately detailed figures of celestial dancers (apsaras) depicting daily adornment, beauty rituals, and classical dance poses.

hotspots.title: Salvi Weavers Guild Heritage
hotspots.text: Historical records link the Solanki rulers of Rani ki Vav directly with royal patronage of the Salvi silk-weaving community in Patan.

title: Chand Baori - Geometric Aquifer 360°
caption: Panoramic 360 view from the central landing across 3,500 symmetrical steps

hotspots.title: Triangular Step Geometry
hotspots.text: Over 3,500 narrow, perfectly chiseled steps arranged in hypnotic double-flight chevron formations descending 13 storeys.

hotspots.title: Subterranean Royal Jharokha
hotspots.text: Multi-level pillared pavilions and resting chambers reserved for royal ceremonies during scorching summer heatwaves.

hotspots.title: Harshat Mata Temple Vista
hotspots.text: Adjacent 8th-century sanctuary dedicated to Harshat Mata, deity of joy, uniting spiritual reverence with desert water conservation.

hotspots.title: Nikumbha Masonry Technology
hotspots.text: Interlocking dry-stone construction using dark porous volcanic basalt and local sandstone that kept pool waters cool year-round.

hotspots.title: Caravan Trade Route to Bagru
hotspots.text: Ancient desert caravan trails linked water stops like Abhaneri with the natural mud-resist indigo dyeing centers of Jaipur.

title: Mehrangarh Fort - Citadel Ramparts 360°
caption: High-altitude 360 panorama atop the towering battlements looking over the Blue City

hotspots.title: Moti Mahal Pierced Screens
hotspots.text: The Pearl Palace features delicate stone lattice screens (jharokhas) and gilded ceiling motifs created by Marwar craftsmen.

hotspots.title: Loha Pol Citadel Gate
hotspots.text: The historic Iron Gate preserving the sacred vermilion impressions of royal consorts commemorating wartime sacrifice.

hotspots.title: Chamunda Devi Bastion
hotspots.text: Fortress deity temple installed by founder Rao Jodha in 1460, guarding the citadel's steepest volcanic rock cliff.

hotspots.title: Kilkila Cannon Battery
hotspots.text: Historic brass ordnance mounted along the upper ramparts commanding an unobstructed view across the Thar Desert horizon.

hotspots.title: Marwar Royal Textile Archives
hotspots.text: The palace treasury preserves invaluable double-ikat silk ceremonial robes commissioned from the master weavers of Patan.
